question: I have booked a train to Gatwick Airport departing at 15:42. I plan to take a taxi from the hotel to the station. The distance from the hotel to the train station is 30 km, and the taxi can travel at a maximum speed of 60 km/h. The security check takes 20 minutes. What is the latest time I should depart to ensure I arrive on time?

steps.description: Locate the train departure time mentioned in the problem statement
Locate the distance from the hotel to the train station mentioned in the problem statement
Locate the maximum speed of the taxi mentioned in the problem statement
Locate the security check time mentioned in the problem statement
Calculate travel time by dividing the distance from step_2 by the speed from step_3
Add the travel time from step_5 and security check time from step_4 to get total time needed
Subtract the total time needed from step_6 from the train departure time from step_1 to find the latest departure time
